Name: Verdant Hollow - a Junimo Nexus
Author: IndieCrossing
Description:
[b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=5]Verdant Hollow ~ A Junimo Nexus

[/size][/font][/b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]﻿A Junimo-built treehouse that connects every corner of the valley — complete with a cozy greenhouse and a touch of magic.

[/font][line][b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=4]Overview[/size]

[/font][/b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]Inspired heavily by the warp Treehouse in [i]Lunatyx’s Legacy Farm[/i], [b]Verdant Hollow[/b] is a  reworked and standalone version of the original warp treehouse.[/font][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]This living nexus of magic and nature connects major expansions through shimmering portals, offering a serene and enchanted travel hub among the trees.[/font][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]Perfect for witchy, forest-loving, or late-game farmers who long for one peaceful place to journey from.
[/font][line][b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=4]Features[/size]
[/font][/b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]Unlock the warp treehouse through the Wizard once you've complete the Community Center or Joja Warehouse. 
[/font][list]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]All [b]Vanilla Obelisk[/b] locations[/font]
[*][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]The [b]Wizard’s Tower[/b] (ideal for magical playthroughs)[/font]
[*][b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]East Scarp[/font][/b]
[*][b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]Ridgeside Village[/font][/b]
[*][b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]Mount Vapius[/font][/b]
[*][b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]Lilybrook[/font][/b]
[*][b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]Sunberry Village[/font][/b]
[/list][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]
[b][size=4]Requirements
[/size]
﻿[/b][/font]500,000g[font=Lucida Sans Unicode][b] 50[/b] Ancient Fruit & 50 Starfruit.

[/font][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]Within the treehouse lies a [b]small greenhouse nook[/b], perfect for cultivating favorite crops, herbs, or mystical plants.[/font][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]Each portal glows softly with Junimo magic beneath the forest canopy — a gentle alternative to cluttering your farm with obelisks. One enchanted hub to unite the world’s wonders.[/font][line][b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=4]Compatibility
[/size]
[/font][/b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]Works seamlessly with:

[/font][list]
[*][b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]Vanilla Stardew Valley[/font][/b]
[*][b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]Stardew Valley Expanded[/font][/b]
[*][b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]East Scarp[/font][/b]
[*][b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]Ridgeside Village[/font][/b]
[*][b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]Visit Mount Vapius[/font][/b]
[*][b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]Lilybrook[/font][/b]
[/list][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][b]
[/b][/font][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]Ideal for [b]witchy[/b], [b]foresty[/b], and [b]cozy[/b] playthroughs.

[size=4]Required Mods[/size]

[list]
[*]Content Patcher
[*]HxW Tilesheets
[*]Lumisteria Tilesheets - Outdoor
[*]DaisyNiko's Tilesheets
[/list]
[/font][line][b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=4]Credits & Thanks

[/size][/font][/b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]Created by: [b]Indie Crossing[/b]
Inspired by and reimagined from the [b]Warp Treehouse in Lunatyx’s Legacy Farm[/b].
Thank you to all of the wonderful mod authors for creating the tilesheets required to make this project happen. 
Special thanks to the [b]Stardew Valley modding community[/b] for their creativity, kindness, and guidance. 💚[/font]
